name: KEMS
tagline: Live reality. Alpha7 optimisation. One clear energy story.
summary: A focused read-only companion for KEMS Alpha7, separating live hardware, digital-twin simulation, Agile Smart Export, scenario comparison and long-term performance data.
build: Alpha7 property dashboard · Agile Smart Export parity · Actual vs KEMS · multi-site appliance groundwork · kems.uk public-site source
principles: Home Assistant and KEMS remain the source of truth for each property.
The property website is read-only and cannot call Home Assistant services.
The public kems.uk site is static and receives no Home Assistant credentials or household telemetry.
Home is always the centre of the energy-flow model.
Live, simulated, shadow and calculated allocation data are visibly labelled.
Agile Smart Export displays KEMS' current optimiser, horizon, safety and digital-twin proof without creating a hardware write path.
What-if scenario replay is read-only and never changes the active KEMS strategy.
KEMS native period summaries are authoritative for Week, Month, Year and All time.
Raspberry Pi installs and updates are sourced from checksum-verified GitHub releases without touching persistent KEMS data.
Raspberry Pi maintenance, updates and encrypted backups are managed locally from the KEMS Settings panel.
Each property keeps its own Home Assistant credentials and KEMS data on its own appliance.
A KEMS Pi can use an existing Home Assistant or optionally host Home Assistant Container locally.
Remote property access is a separate security boundary and is not provided by the public static website.
